note.p: Sir Graves Chamney Haughton was an orientalist and honorary secretary of the Royal Asiatic Society, having been a founding member. Haughton was awarded the highest honour of the East India Company, and spent times as a professor in the East India College at Haileybury. He published a number of academic works before his death from cholera whilst in Paris.
Ed Pope's entry highlights that the 1827 entry at Aldis's may have referred to a different Haughton. However we lack sufficient contextual data to definitively identify this entry.
